recipe.visualDefinition: A chaotic, multi-layered collage featuring high-contrast stencil-style portraits, aggressive hand-scrawled text, and vibrant splashes of primary colors. The style mimics a weathered urban wall covered in wheat-paste posters, graffiti, and paint drips, creating a sense of frantic energy and DIY subculture.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black and white portraits against a saturated, multi-colored background.
Aggressive, overlapping layers of text and imagery creating visual noise.
Juxtaposition of clean geometric frames with messy, organic paint splatters and drips.
Interplay between legible display type and illegible background scribbles.
coreInvariants: High-contrast thresholding on all photographic elements.
Visible paint drips and splatters in primary red, blue, and yellow.
Layered, 'torn' edges on rectangular image inserts.
Hand-written script used as a background texture.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Multiple portraits of varying scales are scattered across the canvas, with the largest in the upper left and smaller ones clustered in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, vibrant magenta block of text diagonally cutting across the center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: A frantic zig-zag path starting from the top-left portrait, following the diagonal text, and ending at the bottom-right portrait cluster.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with 'horror vacui' tendencies, using white space only within the high-contrast portraits.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: White and Black provide the structural foundation through high-contrast imagery.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Primary Blue and Red act as background fields and textural accents.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Magenta and Yellow are used for focal point text and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation colors are pitted against extreme black/white values, creating a jarring, high-energy vibration.

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky strokes with irregular, jagged edges.
Background text is thin, rapid cursive or print mimicking marker scrawl.
Letters are often overlapping or partially obscured by other layers.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main title are slanted and compressed to fit a diagonal baseline.
Lower-right text features elongated vertical strokes that are crossed out with horizontal lines.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive contrast between thick, colorful display lettering and thin, white, structured sans-serif.

preserve: Diagonal orientation of the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy, condensed skeleton for the display text before distressing.
Captures the distressed, jagged edges of the central lettering.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a chaotic mixed-media collage with high-contrast black and white stencil portraits. Add layers of blue and red acrylic paint, drips, and messy hand-written scribbles in the background. Include a white 'X' and various rectangular photo cutouts.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a heavy, condensed, jagged-edged font in bright magenta, rotated 15 degrees. Add the secondary text in a clean, white, condensed sans-serif at the bottom right, underlined with horizontal scratch marks.

verificationChecks: Is the magenta text the primary focal point?
Are the portraits high-contrast black and white with no mid-tones?
Does the background feel like a layered urban wall?
Are there visible paint drips and splatters?

adjustableVariables: Color of the main display text
mustRedesign: Any specific recognizable faces must be replaced with generic high-contrast portraits.
Specific brand names or logos must be replaced with generic text or symbols.
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no smooth gradients are present.
Verify that text overlaps imagery in a messy, non-linear way.
Check that the primary color palette is strictly maintained.
Confirm the 'threshold' effect on portraits is sharp.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast Stencil Portraits] + [Primary Color Paint Drips] + [Diagonal Distressed Block Lettering] + [Hand-written Background Scrawl] to create a [Punk Collage Aesthetic].
